title: malisper/pgrust
claim: malisper/pgrust — Postgres rewritten in Rust, already passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests.
hook: Postgres, rewritten in Rust — and it already passes 100% of Postgres's own regression tests.
why_good: A memory-safe, from-the-ground-up Postgres that already passes the full regression suite is a serious systems feat — the foundation a safer managed Postgres or an embeddable engine could be built on; a rare lead signal in a space usually owned by decades-old C.
value: The engine is not the business; a managed or embedded offering, or enterprise support on a safer Postgres (the Cockroach/ClickHouse path), is — once it reaches production readiness.
risk: Taking a Postgres reimplementation to production trust is a multi-year slog; passing regression tests is far from run-your-bank-on-it, and the incumbent is free, battle-tested and everywhere.

zh.claim: malisper/pgrust —— 用 Rust 重写的 Postgres,已经 100% 通过 Postgres 官方回归测试。
zh.hook: 用 Rust 重写的 Postgres——而且已经 100% 通过了 Postgres 自己的回归测试。
zh.why_good: 一个内存安全、从零重写、且已通过完整回归测试套件的 Postgres,是硬核的系统工程成就——这种底座之上可长出更安全的托管 Postgres 或可嵌入引擎;在通常被几十年老 C 代码统治的领域,这是难得的领先信号。
zh.value: 引擎本身不是生意;在更安全的 Postgres 之上做托管/嵌入式产品或企业支持(Cockroach/ClickHouse 的路子)才是——前提是达到生产可用。
zh.risk: 把一个 Postgres 重写版做到「生产可信」是多年苦役;通过回归测试离「敢让银行用」还差得远,而现有 Postgres 免费、久经沙场、无处不在。
